Title: Shared Setup Saves — Location Management History Row Verification
Preconditions: Office 1604 is open in Navigator. Shared Setup Locations tab is active.
Steps:
1. After SSL save TCs complete, navigate to Location Management History tab
 [ok] Tab loads
2. Sort by Modified On descending (default is ascending)
 [ok] Rows newest-first
3. Read rows newer than suite start time via timestamp-window isolation (2-min buffer)
 [ok] Suite rows isolated
4. Verify at least 1 suite row present
 [ok] Count > 0
5. Verify every suite row has Modified By and Modified On non-empty
 [ok] User + timestamp present per row
6. Informational check: extract unique values from Action/ID/Name columns (cols 59-61) across all suite rows
 [ok] Document SSL column state
7. If SSL columns are empty: document as snapshot-model data gap (informational, not failure)
 [ok] Finding recorded
Expected Result: Shared Setup saves produced history rows (snapshot model). Modified By and Modified On populated per row. SSL-specific columns (Action, ID, Name - cols 59-61) may or may not contain relationship data depending on snapshot behavior. Empty SSL columns are documented as an informational finding, not a test failure. Soft assertions used throughout.
